title: Numerical, serving-latency, transport, and orchestration probes

sources.notes: Historical top-level shell experiment with no functions: selects nominal-off and registered server arms, floor modes, prompt-logprob capture, TTFT and two matrix cells. Nominal off does not clear inherited registration; tee can mask matrix failure. Modeled as non-production arm selection and non-manifest orchestration.

Successor register A/B: boot/warm registered and nominal-off servers, compare 64 generated-token logprobs at gate 0.49, and run selected context cells. Off still inherits ambient registration; warm failures/PSI timeout are nonfatal and tee lacks pipefail.

Real b12x bank versus independently dequantized checkpoint truth; bank/direct scale-layout arms. Enforces cosine >=0.99 and relative L2 <=0.15, then reports the median of synchronized CUDA-event samples.

Fixed top-level diagnostic with no locally defined symbols. Compares FlashInfer-prepared expert bytes with bank and nibble-swapped bytes and prints checkpoint-reference cosine/L2. No timing or executable verdict.
Gate/up weight-and-scale half-order and alternate down-scale-layout bisect. Reports numerical metrics and catches the third-arm exception; descriptive signatures are not gates.

Builds checkpoint-native W4A16, ratio-bakes gate/up scale differences, compares with exact FP32 and reports the median of seven CUDA-event samples. Docstring thresholds are printed/advisory, not enforced.
Three-arm W4A8 attribution: vendor torch oracle B, checkpoint FP32 C, optional serving-style GPU A. CPU-only B-vs-C is available. Writes scores but implements no threshold.
Five cumulative activation/fc2-scale argument arms report nonzero fraction/absmax or caught exceptions. No truth tensor, timing aggregation or acceptance.

Live HTTP DVFS A/B. Times every SSE data line rather than verified text/token delivery, samples sysfs frequency every 5 ms, and averages requests excluding the first when possible. No output-length or quality gate.

Concurrent live completion cells with prompt calibration, usage-token identity, HTTP TTFT/E2E/ITL distributions and monotonic native-trace window attribution. Missing traces/request errors are evidence, not fatal.

Offline native-service affine fit and live HTTP prefill ladder are distinct modes. Chunk ceiling uses ceil(T/C)*(a+b*C)*48 and charges a full final chunk. HTTP medians group by actual prompt count; cache evidence is advisory.
Isolated XPU sgl/vLLM grouped-W4A16 benchmark. Enforces CPU-reference cosine >0.999, then takes the middle of five averaged XPU-event windows and derives logical bandwidth.
Live cold/warm prefill smoke. Quality requires nonempty text and finite selected logprobs; TTFT is actually full non-streamed one-token wall. Token-weighted cold cost and cache speedup are reported.

GuideLLM grid and publication harness. Resume requires rc=0 and measured=true; real measurements require positive duration and a successful request in every report. Capacity uses 4176-token blocks and over-context skips are intentional.
CPU-only matrix audit: only run_manifest.json return_code==0 is OK; missing, corrupt or failed cells abort. Payload/config identity is not inspected.

CPU post-processing gate. Requires equal placement/config/adapter_sha, strictly lower worst-worker load peak, both null controls, and worst logprob delta <=1.5 times null noise. Token/KV equality is informational.

Separates CPU roofline, strict exact-count live SSE measurement, profiler capture, Kineto device-interval analysis and real-minus-dummy HTTP comparison. Wait/write-signal APIs are excluded from device execution.

HTTP-triggered ring-tail diagnostic. Groups M=1 increasing-layer sweeps of length >=40 and reports median service/gaps by attention type. It is not request-window correlated and does not verify output count.

Live context ladder using text-chunk arrivals and usage counts. TPOT is last-minus-first arrival over n-1; short streams are skipped and missing speculative counters become zero. No quality/acceptance threshold.

CPU ABI-compatible immediate-zero timing control. Validates a header prefix and dispatch bounds, zero-fills outputs, records service/buckets, and publishes completion even for invalid poll dispatches. Output is intentionally not numerically valid.

Deterministic FP8 plausibility screen over real checkpoint weights. Regime labels are non-gating. The two labeled combined FP8 scale arms are computationally identical and overwrite the same JSON key. Generic Torch CPU comparison is possible where float8 is supported.
Privileged NVIDIA power/clock control with status, cap, reset, clocks, unlock arms. It samples no timing/quality data and does not validate the documented watt range.

Direct H2D from registered private mmap over an assumed fixed slab. Reports median/min/max/raw event times and registration costs; only main registration/pointer/CUDA prerequisites are hard gates. First-MiB mismatch and throughput are advisory.

Stock-vLLM CUDA admission gate with zero Shooting Brake execution: construction, prefix-cache enabled, minimal semantic/finite-logprob checks, and normally cold/warm speedup >1.5. Absolute wall time is not comparable.
Destructive full-boot local-expert sweep. Records boot/KV/VRAM/cold-wall/mean-ITL rows; point failures and cache-hit contamination do not make the final process fail, and no optimum is selected.
Live capture plus CPU-only diff. Equal length is the only identity gate; max absolute logprob delta must be <= supplied gate. Model/prompt/token IDs/mode are not cross-checked.

Real Marlin bank PoC with independent NumPy oracle. Enforces relative L2 <=0.02 and cosine >=0.999 before median kernel timing; three wall samples time streaming H2D+repack. Projections are not measured forwards.
In-process all-CUDA/hybrid/all-out context-concurrency matrix. Engine-yield timing divides multi-token gaps across new tokens; exceptions abort but output length/content are not gated.
Compute, synthetic-b12x, real-vendor-b12x, stream/compute overlap and full-registration modes. Mode-specific kill conditions are returned strings only and are modeled as advisory.

24-cell GuideLLM context/profile harness stored beside results. Resume checks nonempty JSON+CSV only; dry-run creates directories, and prefix_cache=disabled is a label rather than server configuration.

Fresh post-hoc/pre-emptive benchmark legs followed by compare_preemptive.py. The runner supplies no null controls, so the comparator's successful quietness verdict is unreachable through this invocation.
Hybrid/all-CUDA/hybrid-stream launcher. File existence alone resumes an arm; absence of set -e means child failure is logged then normally masked by echo/sleep and the final success-looking message.
Live TTFT/context bracket plus hard-coded PCIe link-state sampling. Same prompts permit cache reuse; text chunks, not usage, count outputs. Partial failures/sysfs misses are recorded without a gate.

Assumed fixed-slab fault/stage/pinned-H2D/serialized/pageable ceiling benchmark. Each transfer arm emits raw samples plus median/min/max/GiB/s; 48-layer and overlap values are projections. No byte or throughput verdict.

assumptions: All assigned files are experiment, qualification, historical, or benchmark-control surfaces; invoking production-format banks or a production-shaped server does not make a probe a production implementation.
The bounded model uses three integer timing samples to expose aggregation and ordering; real programs retain their source-specific counts, clocks, warmups, trimming, percentiles and raw samples.
Cosine is represented in ten-thousandths and relative L2 in thousandths; tensor arithmetic, floating-point rounding, device scheduling and HTTP delivery remain external implementation behavior.
A descriptive source comment, printed regime label, comparison constant or returned kill-condition string is advisory unless the implementation changes process outcome.
HTTP TTFT/ITL, in-process engine-yield time, device events, native service traces, Kineto engine intervals and host-wall transport time are not interchangeable.
Several transport probes assume fixed bank offsets/strides without parsing complete identity; model admission makes that assumption visible rather than claiming provenance.
External checkpoints, expert banks, vLLM, GuideLLM, FlashInfer, sgl-kernel-xpu, CUDA/XPU runtimes, Linux sysfs and native trace files are dependencies and are not modeled internally.

implementation_checks.description: On reduced CPU fixtures, compare arm_b_their_oracle with exact checkpoint-dequantized FP32 across gate/up half-order and scale-layout variants; verify wrong-order degradation is observable without invoking the GPU arm.
Construct a tiny packed-int4 fixture and compare dequant_ref/cpu_reference with direct NumPy signed-nibble group-128 SwiGLU, including repeated routes and normalized weights.
Use finite CPU tensors to compare FP16 and E4M3 round trips, cancellation amplification, block-size arms, and the two currently identical combined-FP8 labels.
Feed same-length and length-mismatched JSON arrays around the exact max-absolute-delta boundary; separately demonstrate that equal-length different provenance is not rejected.
Evaluate CPU JSON fixtures for identity mismatch, absent versus complete null controls, NaN legacy logprobs, equality at 1.5 times the null floor, and strictly lower versus equal load peak.
Inspect temporary manifest fixtures covering missing, corrupt, absent return_code, nonzero and zero return_code states; confirm payload contents are intentionally ignored.
Compare affine fixture calculations across chunk caps, including a non-divisible token total to confirm that the final partial chunk is charged as full.
Analyse a small Kineto JSON fixture containing device kernels, overlapping intervals and wait/write-signal APIs; compare category sums with interval union and confirm waits are excluded.
Source-inspect or CPU-drive a valid and invalid row-count dispatch to compare completion release, zero-fill validity, dispatch/error counters and service bucket accounting.
Source-level call-graph comparison with compare_preemptive.main: confirm the runner supplies neither --null-a nor --null-b and therefore cannot satisfy the comparator's quietness prerequisite.
Source-inspect shell status flow for a nonzero child followed by echo and sleep, and contrast it with a strict harness; also check that any regular JSON-path file is accepted as cached.
